description:
The image depicts a traditional oven and kitchen area, featuring a large, white brick oven with multiple openings, including a large door, two smaller doors, and a chimney. A long-handled tool is attached to the wall beside the oven.

In the foreground, a wooden table supports a stack of round, metal pans or molds, while two wooden barrels sit on the floor in front of the oven. Various other tools and equipment are scattered around the room.
